scope: Every published HTML document and its visitor-visible prose, headings, link labels, controls, and search/social description metadata.
method: Human semantic review against the cited authoritative sources. Exact quotations require exact-text verification; factual paraphrases require direct support; interpretation must be labeled; unsupported material is corrected or removed. The CI hash invalidates approval whenever published wording changes.
limitations: This ledger records semantic review; a hash is only a change detector and is not evidence that a claim is true. Script-embedded answer banks are governed separately by source_integrity_inventory.py and fail-closed runtime policy.

New Christ-centered eternal marriage study reviewed against official scripture, temple, handbook, abuse-help, and general conference sources. Sealing conditions, the Holy Spirit of Promise, individual agency, equal partnership, safety, and the full belonging of single, divorced, and widowed members are stated with pastoral guardrails. Four visual talks were verified as unique across the site and matched to official source thumbnails. Applications and reflection prompts are labeled as study invitations rather than promises about individual outcomes. The six-scene symbolic marriage journey was reviewed as interpretation rather than a claim to portray a specific historical couple or temple ordinance. Each era is connected to its cited official source; Christ remains Savior and Teacher rather than a romantic participant. Civilly married, single, divorced, widowed, interfaith, and not-yet-sealed people are explicitly affirmed as people of equal divine worth and belonging.
